evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce P-ContextBench, a realistic, verifiable, and scalable benchmark for evaluating personal-context understanding.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for personal tasks, yet evaluating their safe use of personal context remains difficult because such contexts are private, fragmented, dynamic, and socially situated.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Cost-effective state-of-the-art (SOTA) LLMs relevant to personal agents achieve below 60% accuracy on temporal tracking, higher-level pattern inference, and constraint-aware action-boundary decisions, with fewer than 10% of test cases answered correctly across all three repeated runs.
